description: This file defines the UserSession class implementing user account session management in Drupal, including user roles, permissions, language preferences, and magic methods for property access.

classes.name: UserSession
classes.description: Implements user session management, including roles, permissions, language preferences, and property access magic methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a UserSession object with optional values.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the list of roles assigned to the user, optionally excluding locked roles.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission via the permission checker service.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Determines if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Determines if the user is anonymous.

methods.name: getPreferredLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred language code, falling back to default if not set.

methods.name: getPreferredAdminLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred admin language code, falling back to default if not set.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name, possibly altered by a hook.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access properties, with deprecation warning for 'name'.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if properties are set, with deprecation warning for 'name'.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set properties, with deprecation warning for 'name'.
